facts.business: Hindustan Organic Chemicals Limited (HOCL) is a Central Public Sector Enterprise engaged in the manufacturing of organic chemicals.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: 1) Loan of Rs. 453.01 lakhs to subsidiary with interest not charged since 2023-24 due to non-payment; 2) Board composition non-compliance with Companies Act 2013 and SEBI LODR; 3) Status of implementation of Government approved restructuring plan.

key_risks: Non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulations leading to fines from BSE
Board composition not in compliance with Companies Act 2013 and SEBI LODR
Subsidiary loan default and interest non-charging since 2023-24
Implementation risks of Government approved restructuring plan
Continuous losses leading to no transfer to reserves
facts.related_party_note: Loan advanced to subsidiary amounting to Rs. 453.01 lakhs at interest rate 10.25% to 14.50%; interest charging stopped from 2023-24 due to non-payment; subsidiary repaid Rs. 1,075.05 lakhs interest and Rs. 286.98 lakhs principal during the year.
